text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-chan. I'm so glad we get to 
participate together in the fan meeting's 
stage play.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I came up with lots of ideas today 
too. Like this stage direction, for 
example!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"An interactive, audience-participation 
experience that offers a taste of the 
extraordinary"? Oh! Sounds great, doesn't 
it? I think it'd be super fun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Like the ending changing based on 
audience votes! Or being dragged away by 
an actor and roped into becoming an 
accomplice to the crime... like that?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah...! When you're actually 
involved, the immersion is totally 
different! Jumping into the extraordinary 
instead of just watching from afar is so 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Besides, didn't you say you wanted 
to make it a musical? So...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I want to sing, dance, and do fan 
service"? Sounds great! That's so Tracen 
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then how about handing out small glow 
sticks to represent the gems in the 
story!? If everyone waves them, the venue 
will look gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...That's Kiseki-chan for you. Coming up 
with one idea after another like that."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But—no. That's all the more reason I can't 
afford to lose!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's in variety of ideas, I have 
no intention of letting myself be 
overwhelmed!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...! This... pressure! Ah, as expected of 
Almond Eye...! However—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, me too! I'll show you something 
even more fun!"
